To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Choco-SGD is a decentralized training method that can achieve linear speedup in number of devices with arbitrarily high compression ratios.
we propose the use  of  communication compression for decentralized training, and demonstrate its practical benefits in two key scenarios.
Choco-SDG is the first decentralized deep learning algorithm that achieves linear speedup for arbitrary communication compression.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following key contributions:
decentralized training of deep neural networks over a peer-to-peer (P2P) network of user devices.
the design of decentralized deep learning algorithms that achieve high accuracy with low communication costs, in the context of arbitrary communication compression.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

our algorithm is able to train large-scale neural networks on decentralized data in a decentralized fashion, with arbitrary compression, while achieving linear speedup in a distributed setting, while also achieving state-of-the-art performance in a centralized datacenter setting.
the algorithm proposed in the paper achieves linear speedup for arbitrary high compression ratio on non-convex optimization problems and non-IID data.

the paper proposes an interesting approach for decentralized deep learning with arbitrary communication compression, and that the results demonstrate the practical performance in two key scenarios, namely the training of deep neural networks over decentralized user devices and in a datacenter.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that decentralized training with arbitrary compression ratios is possible, that it can be applied to deep learning, and that the algorithm can be applied both in the peer-to-peer and the data center context.

we show that communication compression can be a powerful tool for enabling decentralized training of deep learning, and that it is a key enabler for scaling deep learning to very large numbers of devices.
we show that decentralized deep learning with arbitrary communication compression is possible and can achieve good results in practice.
The main takeaway from our work is that
compression is a key element to enable decentralized training, and can be used for a wide range of compression ratios and network settings.
compression can be a powerful tool to improve communication efficiency, while maintaining the same convergence guarantees as the uncompressed case.
communication compression enables decentralized training to scale up to thousands of workers, while achieving state-of-the-art performance.
